description: Server-time rule: session start and end, WhiteGlove parts and per-event server times. C# ServerTime and TS serverTime must reproduce every expectation to the millisecond. See README.md.

cases.name: baseline
cases.note: Clock correct; start = IME history 90 s before the agent; final duration = device span.

cases.name: constant-ahead-9h
cases.note: Whole session 9 h ahead: duration unchanged, start converted by the run-1 offset.

cases.name: constant-behind-3h
cases.note: Whole session 3 h behind: duration unchanged, live start corrected by +3 h.

cases.name: run2-clock-2h-back
cases.note: Run 2 starts with the clock 2 h behind: start stays in run 1, duration = server span (today 34 s).

cases.name: live-step-back-4m10s
cases.note: Live step -4:10 mid-session: today too short by 4:10; server duration correct.

cases.name: wg-part1-step-27m
cases.note: WhiteGlove: +27 min step in Part 1, one event spooled across it (must not become the start); Part 1 and Part 2 in server time.

cases.name: end-upload-late-62s
cases.note: Terminal upload delayed 62 s: median of three ignores it, no false correction.

cases.name: start-upload-late-70s
cases.note: First upload delayed 70 s: start offset = median of the first three uploads.

cases.name: flicker-one-upload
cases.note: One upload in a wrong era (17x +-66 h flicker): ignored; duration = device span.

cases.name: no-sent-at
cases.note: Agent without X-Send-Time-Utc: nothing computable, callers keep today's behaviour.

cases.name: history-40min-before-agent
cases.note: Start anchor waited 40 min (history read at agent start): still the start, as today.

cases.name: guard-2h
cases.note: History 3 h before the agent is ignored (2-h guard as today); 50 min is accepted.

cases.name: sweep-end
cases.note: Sweep completion (CompletedAt between events): last live activity event before it.

cases.name: end-not-history-event
cases.note: CompletedAt equals a SystemTimelineWatcher record: not an activity event, last live one is used.

cases.name: wg-stable
cases.note: WhiteGlove, stable clock: Part 1 + Part 2 equal the device spans (pause excluded).

cases.name: frame1-closes-on-step
cases.note: Clock jumps 2 h back inside run 1: post-step events look earlier on the device clock but never move the start.

cases.name: running-unconfirmed-upload
cases.note: Running, newest upload 90 s late: its history event is held back until the next upload shows the clock unchanged (start may still move earlier).

cases.name: running-confirmed-upload
cases.note: Same session one upload later: the late upload was a delay, its history event is the start.

cases.name: first-upload-without-agent-start
cases.note: The first upload carries no agent_started: run 1 still begins with it and the rule has a start; ingest follows only sessions whose first upload carries agent_started.

cases.name: wg-part2-clock-back-swept
cases.note: WhiteGlove Part 2 on a clock 4 days back, closed by the sweep at LastEventAt (a Part 1 time): the end stays where CompletedAt points, Part 2 does not fit the duration, its start is still reported.
